rows.answer: 部分回答：价格观察范围Malaysia 2026-09 的消费价格同比变化为 1.8%，环比为 0.1%。这是代表性消费篮子的价格变化，不是个人账单。解释生活成本压力还需要收入、支出权重与实际账单；不能只凭同比率判断生活是否更便宜。 本次可见涨幅较高的类别包括酒类与烟草（2.8%）、个人护理、社会保障及其他商品与服务（2.8%）、交通（2.5%）；这是各类涨幅，不是对总通胀的贡献分解，也不能据此认定主要成因。返回相应世界观察

Partial answer: price observationsFor Malaysia in 2026-09, reported consumer-price change was 1.8% year on year and 0.1% month on month. This describes a representative basket, not personal bills. Income, spending weights and actual bills are still needed to explain household cost pressure; the inflation rate alone does not establish affordability. Categories with higher observed increases include Alcoholic Beverages & Tobacco (2.8%), Personal Care, Social Protection & Miscellaneous Goods & Services (2.8%), Transport (2.5%). These are category rates, not contributions to total inflation or established causes.Return to the World observations

Insufficient evidence for a conclusionThe verified endpoint supplies a Langkawi weather forecast, not measured rainfall, reservoir storage or agricultural output. Without aligned hydrology and production observations, it cannot establish local supply changes or household impacts.Return to the World observations

Insufficient evidence for a conclusionThe BNM endpoints expose loan application and approval fields by purpose, but these sources do not establish matched application counts, approval/rejection counts or a common cohort; the measurement unit was not established in the inspected API schema. They cannot yield a mortgage approval rate or establish that approval is becoming harder. Rates and loan totals do not replace those missing observations.Return to the World observations
